issues.detail: R2 example expected q equals d on same negedge, but state says update_during_reset and reset priority; example omits reset field so reset value is undefined, making expected q=18/200/7 unverifiable and likely wrong if reset defaults high.
issues.spec_evidence: All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk.

issues.detail: R1 example third vector reset=0 expects q=52, but with reset released the negedge should capture d=0, so expected should be 0 not 52.
R3 example third vector reset=0 expects q=52, but released reset should capture d=99, so expected should be 99 not 52.
Spec does not state reset value width/behavior when reset asserted at non-negedge; contract treats reset as synchronous only at negedge, but alternative could be asynchronous reset.
issues.alternative: Reset is asynchronous active-high, so q becomes 0x34 immediately when reset rises, independent of clk edge.
